suite.title: MCP resource read failures stay inside the ndx turn instead of crashing the CLI

reproduction.title: Missing MCP resource currently reproduces a request-level failure
reproduction.test: Exercise read_mcp_resource with an unreadable local resource URI and capture the pre-fix behavior.

steps.instruction: Run a focused tool execution against read_mcp_resource using server=local and a missing file URI.
steps.expected: Before the fix, the tool throws a readable error matching the user-observed failure path.

reproduction.passCriteria: The failing resource path is reproducible without requiring an interactive user session.

implementation.title: Agent loop converts tool exceptions into model-visible tool results
implementation.test: A throwing tool call must not reject the whole turn; it must produce a tool output item containing the error.

steps.instruction: Patch the agent loop tool execution path so registry.execute exceptions are caught per tool call.
steps.expected: executeToolCalls returns a tool output item for failed tools and continues processing later calls.

steps.instruction: Run a focused Node regression that registers a throwing task tool and invokes executeToolCalls.
steps.expected: The process exits 0 and prints a tool output containing an error object instead of throwing.

implementation.passCriteria: Tool execution failures are represented as model-visible tool outputs.

documentation.title: Docs record the tool failure containment contract
documentation.test: Package docs describe that task tool exceptions are contained as tool results.

steps.instruction: Update package testing docs with the new regression suite path and the tool error containment contract.

documentation.passCriteria: Docs point to the strict JSON regression record.

release.title: Build, deploy, publish, and install the fixed version
release.test: The fixed package builds, deploys, publishes as 0.1.41, and installs from Verdaccio.

steps.instruction: Run yarn install --immutable, yarn build, and npm run deploy.
steps.expected: All commands exit 0 and Docker compose refresh completes.

steps.instruction: Publish @neurondev/ndx-core@0.1.41 and @neurondev/ndx@0.1.41 to Verdaccio, then install @neurondev/ndx@0.1.41 into a clean prefix.
steps.expected: npm view returns 0.1.41 for both packages and installed ndx/ndxserver bins report 0.1.41.

release.passCriteria: The fixed version is available from Verdaccio and install verification passes.
